model: TUDOR Ranger 36 M79930-0001 (steel, black dial, large numerals, 3-column steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Ranger 36 build from the Ranger 39 recipe, re-measured on the 36 mm photo (14.0 px/mm, pivot row 667): case, bezel, crown and bracelet from the photo silhouette and joints; hand outlines measured on this photo. The black dial with Arabic numerals, indices, print and minute track comes from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette into the bracelet; the top is brushed and slopes down toward the bracelet

bezel.note: smooth fixed bezel: flat brushed top from bezel_in to bezel_out, polished chamfer toward the dial, rounded outer edge (read from the photo, no facets or ribs)

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, 0.05 mm wider than the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide the ones in the map; the last point sits at the traced length; hands and hub use the steel_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

bracelet.note: Flat bracelet of three brushed columns. Joint positions (dark lines) read from this photo with brightness scans, top and bottom separately: outer columns top y 369 / 285, bottom 967 / 1043 / 1097.5; centre column top 388 / 345 / 263, bottom 946.5 / 993 / 1059 / 1111 (photo px, listed as mm from the pivot row 667, 14.0 px/mm). The first pieces run under the case end. centre_x_mm = the vertical joint lines between the columns, [|y|, left x, right x] (photo x 381.3 / 516.0 top, 380 / 516 bottom, pivot x 451). No curl, no polished channels.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
